skill.name: check-tracking
skill.description: Check that Product Metrics conversion tracking works for a store, with the productmetrics CLI or the Product Metrics MCP server: store connection active, store linked to the property, Google Ads conversion actions present, Enhanced Conversions accepted, Meta Conversions API destination connected, and the latest purchase received. Use it when someone asks "is my tracking working?", "why are conversions missing in Google Ads?", "did my test order arrive?", after finishing setup, or when Google Ads conversions drop while the store's own sales do not. Reads only; it changes nothing.
skill.summary: Run read-only checks on Product Metrics setup, purchase receipt, and conversion delivery for one store.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: All 42 static alerts are false positives: the text shows Markdown examples, scoped diagnostics, and documentation links. No evidence of prompt injection or an external transfer of order data was found. The workflow requests unnecessary order details and overstates what a primary Google Ads action guarantees.

remediation.issue: The purchase check requests order details beyond what is needed and instructs agents to quote errors verbatim.
remediation.suggestion: Stop after matching the order unless the user requests more details. Mask order identifiers by default and remove sensitive values from errors before quoting them.

remediation.issue: The guidance equates one primary purchase action with correct bidding and exactly-once counting.
remediation.suggestion: Describe primary status as one input to bidding. Ask the advertiser to verify campaign goals, counting settings, and transaction deduplication before changing an action.

semantic_findings.title: Purchase checks collect and report more detail than needed
semantic_findings.description: The workflow requests margin and customer classification after matching the order. It also asks agents to report order details and quote errors without a redaction rule.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The extra detail request and verbatim error instruction are explicit. No evidence shows that the skill sends the data to an outside recipient.

semantic_findings.title: Bidding advice overstates what primary status guarantees
semantic_findings.description: The workflow says one primary purchase action keeps bidding correct and counts each purchase once. Primary status alone does not establish correct bidding or deduplication.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The guarantee appears in explicit guidance to advertisers. The advertiser must make any changes, but following the advice without checking campaign goals can affect bidding.

content.value_statement: Missing ad conversions can be hard to trace when your store still records sales. Check store setup, purchase receipt, and ad destination status in one report.
actual_capabilities: Check whether the selected store is active and linked to its Product Metrics property.
Inspect Google Ads conversion actions and Enhanced Conversions acceptance status.
Inspect connection and delivery status for a configured Meta destination.
Check the latest Cloudflare purchase or look for a paid order in the storefront's ten most recent orders.
Compare store revenue with conversion counts by action using the Product Metrics MCP reports.
Check Shopware setup status and whether any jobs are quarantined.
limitations: Requires the Product Metrics CLI or MCP server with access to the chosen store.
Does not change tracking setup, accept terms, or change ad bidding settings.
The purchase check does not verify that an individual order was attributed in Google Ads or Meta.
Unpaid orders are not sent, and older orders may fall outside the ten-order lookup.

use_cases.title: Verify a new store setup
use_cases.description: Check whether the store and tracking installation are active and linked to the intended property.

use_cases.title: Investigate a drop in ad conversions
use_cases.description: Compare store revenue with Google Ads conversions by action and report which tracking checks failed or were unavailable.

use_cases.title: Verify receipt of a paid test order
use_cases.description: Look for a selected paid order and report whether Product Metrics received it.

prompt_templates.title: Check one store
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether [store name] is connected and linked to the right property. Tell me which checks failed or were unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Match a paid order
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether Product Metrics received paid order [order number] for [store name]. Mask the order number in your report.

prompt_templates.title: Check ad destinations
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Google Ads conversion actions and Enhanced Conversions for [store name]. If Meta is configured, check its delivery status too. Do not change settings.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a reporting gap
prompt_templates.prompt: Using Product Metrics MCP, compare store revenue and Google Ads conversions by action for [store name] over [date range]. Separate observed changes from possible causes.

output_examples.input: Check tracking for the demo storefront.
output: Tracking needs attention: The storefront is not linked to the selected property.
The store connection is active. Google Ads actions are present.
No purchase was checked. Review the property link under Ecommerce platforms.

output_examples.input: Did Product Metrics receive my paid test order?
output: Product Metrics received the paid test order ending in 4821 at 14:05 UTC. Its value was 29.00 USD.
This confirms receipt in Product Metrics. It does not confirm attribution in Google Ads or Meta.

best_practices: Name the store or property before running a check if the account contains several.
Use an existing paid order when possible and share only the details needed to identify it.
Keep store receipt and ad attribution separate, and report any check that could not be read.
anti_patterns: Treat an unpaid order as proof that tracking is broken.
Treat a missing result in the ten-order lookup as proof that an older order was never received.
Ask the skill to change conversion actions, bidding goals, or store settings.

faq.question: What access does this skill need?
faq.answer: It needs a Product Metrics CLI or MCP connection with access to the store you want to check.

faq.question: Can the skill repair tracking?
faq.answer: No. It reads status and describes what you can change in the relevant app.

faq.question: Which store platforms does the workflow cover?
faq.answer: It covers Shopify, WooCommerce, Shopware, Lightspeed, and Magento store connections, plus websites using Cloudflare Tracking.

faq.question: Can I check an unpaid test order?
faq.answer: No. The tracking workflow sends only paid orders.

faq.question: Does finding my order confirm ad attribution?
faq.answer: No. Finding the order confirms receipt in Product Metrics. It does not prove that an ad platform attributed that purchase.

faq.question: Can I compare store sales with Google Ads conversions?
faq.answer: Yes, with Product Metrics MCP connected. The skill compares store revenue with Google Ads conversions grouped by action.
